## Purpose
Static data only: `colors.json` maps programming language names to their GitHub colour and trending URL. It is consumed by `getLanguageColor` in [[src-utils]] to colour language dots on project cards.

## Key concepts
- `colors.json` is keyed by language name; each value is `{ color: string | null, url }`.

## Gotchas
- Some languages have `color: null`; `getLanguageColor` falls back to `'gray'` for those and for unknown names.
- The file is about 1400 lines; do not read it whole.
